patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section with a large, bold headline on the left and a stylized illustration on the right, creating a dynamic initial focal point.
Prominent use of vibrant orange-red as a primary accent and for full-width section backgrounds, creating strong visual breaks and high energy.
A full-screen overlay navigation menu slides in from the right when the hamburger icon is clicked, covering the entire viewport with a dark backdrop and light text links.
Headlines use a very large, bold, condensed sans-serif typeface, providing strong hierarchy and a modern, impactful feel.

technique_notes: A full-screen navigation overlay is triggered by a hamburger icon, sliding into view with a dark background and light text links, while the icon animates into a close button. This creates an immersive navigation experience.
Content sections are defined by full-bleed background colors, primarily white and a vibrant orange-red, providing clear visual separation and a bold aesthetic.
The hero features a custom, stylized illustration with a clean, almost vector-like appearance, complementing the bold typography without overwhelming it.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, condensed sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) create strong impact, contrasted with smaller, lighter body text and uppercase navigation labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with no visible rounded corners on elements or buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in the hero and full-screen menu, with generous vertical spacing between content blocks, contributing to a clean and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its energetic and bold use of a vibrant orange-red as a dominant accent color for large sections, immediately grabbing attention. This is paired with a unique full-screen overlay navigation that provides an immersive and modern user experience, moving beyond standard dropdown menus.
